title: security: rbac-v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging fix
author: Priya Kulkarni
body:
Motivation: A recent compliance review surfaced a gap in RBAC v2 enforcement for KMS region pinning. Certain service-account flows were able to use customer-managed keys in a different region when RBAC policy included a kms_residency constraint. This PR fixes the policy evaluation bug and strengthens audit logging for KMS operations so that cross-region key access attempts are recorded with explicit key and region metadata.

Background: RBAC v2 supports a kms_residency predicate intended to restrict use of customer-managed keys to a single region. During evaluation we were solely checking the resource metadata but were not consistently validating request-level kms_key_region reported by the key provider (KMS plugin) in all code paths (notably delegations and service-account impersonation flows). Additionally, audit events emitted on denied requests lacked normalized kms_key_id and kms_region fields, making post-incident analysis difficult.

What this PR does: 1) Fixes RBAC v2 evaluator to compare request.kms_region (from KMS plugin context) to resource.kms_residency when kms_residency is present on the RBAC rule or resource. 2) Adds a strict deny path if regions mismatch for customer-managed keys and records a clear reason for the denial in the response and audit log. 3) Enhances audit logging to include kms_key_id, kms_region, policy_rule_id, and evaluation_reason for both allow and deny results. 4) Adds migration + validation tooling to backfill kms_residency metadata for existing key bindings created via the installer. 5) Adds unit and integration tests covering impersonation/delegation and cross-region rejection.

Files changed (high level): security/rbac_v2/evaluator.go - policy evaluation fix and additional logging hooks; security/rbac_v2/evaluator_test.go - new tests; plugins/kms/plugin.go - populate request context with kms_region/kms_key_id; audit/logging/kms_audit.go - normalized audit event schema and emitter; private-installer/migrations/202602_backfill_kms_residency.go - backfill; docs/security/kms-region-pinning.md - doc update and rollout notes; CI: added integration matrix for cross-region KMS scenarios.

Testing: Unit tests added for the evaluator; integration tests run in CI against a mock KMS that simulates cross-region tokens. Initially an integration job failed due to test ordering (flaky environment variable leak). I fixed the test isolation and re-ran the matrix; all checks passed. Manual verification steps: validated deny responses from dedicated and private deployments and confirmed new audit events in the observability console include kms_key_id and kms_region.

Rollout plan: Feature gate enabled behind feature flag rbac_v2_kms_region_pin. The gate is enabled by default for staging and disabled by default for some older dedicated customers until we have completed a gradual migration to populate kms_residency metadata. Migration tooling included in this PR can be run as a one-off. Monitor: alert on unexpected increases in denied KMS operations after gate flip.

Rollback plan: disable feature flag to restore previous permissive behavior while we investigate.

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration tests added - [x] Migration/backfill included - [x] Docs updated - [x] Reviewed and approved by security leads

Related: ENG-3421, SEC-118, SUP-2345.

security_impact_summary: Prevents cross-region use of customer-managed keys when kms_residency is set. Audit logs now include kms_key_id and kms_region to improve post-incident analysis.
test_plan_summary: Unit tests for evaluator logic, integration tests using mock KMS to simulate cross-region behavior, manual verification steps included in PR body.
